import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Pivot the data to have years as columns and country codes as rows
df_pivot = df.pivot(index='Country Code', columns='Series Name', values=[col for col in df.columns if col.startswith('19') or col.startswith('20')])

# Flatten the multi-index columns
df_pivot.columns = df_pivot.columns.droplevel(0)

# Extract the relevant variables
relevant_columns = [
    'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)',
    'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)',
    'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)',
    'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)'
]

# Filter the dataset to include only the relevant columns
df_filtered = df_pivot[relevant_columns]

# Drop rows with missing values
df_filtered = df_filtered.dropna()

df_filtered.head()
